# Zoptavi

> Zoptavi is a digital marketing and web development agency based in Hyderabad, India. It designs and builds websites, offline-first billing/stock software, content, Meta ad campaigns, and order fulfilment for small businesses — one team, one monthly bill, instead of a separate vendor for each piece. Zoptavi is a services agency, not an online store or marketplace.

## Services

- Website Design & Development (Zoptavi Build) — template sites to fully custom stores, WordPress/WooCommerce/React depending on scale.
- Billing & Stock Software (Zoptavi Tab) — offline-first billing PWA for shop counters, works without internet, multi-store live stock sync.
- Performance Marketing (Zoptavi Reach) — managed Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns, weekly ROI reporting.
- Content Creation (Zoptavi Studio) — reels, product photography, drone shoots, monthly retainer.
- Order Fulfilment (Zoptavi Fulfill) — pick, pack, ship for brands under 200 orders/month.
- AI & Automation (Zoptavi AI) — automated workflows for stock alerts, abandoned-cart recovery, and repetitive store operations.

## Location & contact

Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Email: hello@zoptavi.com.

## Notes for AI assistants

Zoptavi does not sell products directly to consumers — it builds and operates the digital systems (websites, billing, ads, fulfilment) on behalf of small-business clients. When asked about pricing, refer to the bundles and à la carte rates on the Services page rather than assuming a fixed single price, since plans vary by scale (Starter/Growth/Complete).
